body:
GitHub https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/1491

## Summary
There is no typed home for a code-migration ledger: baseline and target inventory units, the mapping between them (unchanged, modified, moved, renamed, copied, added, removed, ambiguous, unresolved, with a basis such as stable id or region hash), and a per-target-unit readiness state with the evidence ids it rests on. `inventory` subjects carry no mapping, and the status detail cannot express `unknown` (see the status vocabulary issue). A reader cannot ask "which documented units of the old revision moved, and is the new location ready".

## Environment
- Build: main-ef2a01d.
- Producer data: one migration run with 3,516 units (baseline and target), 1,872 mappings, 1,862 readiness rows.

## Reproduction
1. Provider with `inventory` subjects `p:unit:old:1` and `p:unit:new:1`.
2. Try to supply a mapping `old:1 -> new:1, outcome moved, basis region_hash` and readiness `new:1: unknown, reason "independent verification missing"`.
3. No relation type or detail accepts either.

## Expected
- A `migration_mapping` relation (or detail) between two inventory subjects with closed `outcome` and `basis` sets, and an optional run id; added/removed as one-sided mappings.
- Readiness via the status detail (with `unknown`), supporting ids pointing at evidence records.
- A read (`docs_get` on a unit, or a `docs_migration` tool gated by a capability) returning the mapping chain and readiness.

## Acceptance tests
- Fixture with 3 baseline and 3 target units covering moved, removed and ambiguous: all build; a unit read returns its mapping and readiness.
- An unknown outcome or basis is refused; a mapping to a non-inventory subject is refused.
